6 6 9 6 6 6 6 6 6 6 6 6
6 6 9 6 6 9 6 6 6 9 6 6
6 9 6 9 6 6 6 6 6 6 6 6
6 6 6 6 6 6 6 6 6 6 6 6'''
test=[list(map(int,r.split())) for r in rows_s.splitlines()]
def comps(g, color, diag=True):
  H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); ans=[]
  steps=[(dr,dc) for dr in (-1,0,1) for dc in (-1,0,1) if (dr or dc) and (diag or (abs(dr)+abs(dc)==1))]
  for r in range(H):
    for c in range(W):
      if g[r][c]==color and (r,c) not in seen:
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); x=[]
        while q:
          a,b=q.pop();x.append((a,b))
          for dr,dc in steps:
            t=(a+dr,b+dc)
            if 0<=t[0]<H and 0<=t[1]<W and g[t[0]][t[1]]==color and t not in seen:seen.add(t);q.append(t)
        ans.append(x)
  return sorted(ans,key=len,reverse=True)
for a,b in [(0,12),(13,25)]:
  g=test[a:b]
  print('section',a, '8 comps',[(len(x),[(r,c) for r,c in x]) for x in comps(g,9)])
  print('4 comps',[(len(x),[(r,c) for r,c in x]) for x in comps(g,9,False)])
